result.rationale: site_settings.yml adds feed_polling_enabled with `default: false`, and the spec at spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb only stubs one setting per test (e.g. the 'requires feed_polling_url' test stubs only feed_polling_url to nil). Since feed_polling_enabled? remains false by default, PollFeed#execute short-circuits at the first condition, so poll_feed is never called regardless — the test passes even if the embed_by_username/feed_polling_url guards in execute are removed. The added tests therefore don't actually verify the guards they claim to, a verifiable defect in the newly added test code.

adjudication.rationale: In Jobs::PollFeed#execute, poll_feed runs only if feed_polling_enabled? && feed_polling_url.present? && embed_by_username.present?. In spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb, the tests "requires feed_polling_url" and "requires embed_by_username" only stub one setting each (feed_polling_url or embed_by_username) but do not stub feed_polling_enabled? to true. Since the new site setting feed_polling_enabled defaults to false (config/site_settings.yml), PollFeed#execute will not call poll_feed regardless, so those tests would still pass even if the corresponding guard checks were removed.
